newsitem.title: USA: Vornado buys Puerto Rico property from Kmart.
newsitem.headline: Vornado buys Puerto Rico property from Kmart.

text.p: Vornado Realty Trust said Friday it bought a shopping center in San Juan, Puerto Rico, from Kmart Corp for $74 million.
Vornado said that of the purchase price it will finance $63 million in new, 10-year debt.
The property purchased, Monteheidra Town Center, is 525,000 square feet, including a 135,000 square-foot Kmart shop.
Vornado also said it has acquired Kmart's 50 percent interest in the Caguas Centrum Shopping Center currently under construction in Caguas, Puerto Rico.
The shopping center will contain 485,000 square feet, including a 123,000 square-foot Kmart store and a 146,000 square-foot Sears, Roebuck and Co Inc store.
Vornado, an integrated equity real estate investment trust, said the deals are its first acqusitions in Puerto Rico.
